question: Starting from the contracting iterative-shift seeds, can a generated pose reach exact static feasibility when every probe re-derives contacts? Unlike the fixed-map descent, the contact set may appear or disappear between probes, so the descent explores the true piecewise residual landscape.
hypothesis: If live-contact descent floors nonzero at every seed, the contact family reachable by coordinate moves from these seeds cannot support the model; if it reaches ~0 and certifies feasible, the first passive-equilibrium pose is found (a static witness, not standing).
units: Native MuJoCo model units; residual R is dimensionless (scaled balance error)
controls: every probe re-derives first-contact height, the five-depth grid, contacts, tendon limits and bias at the trial pose — no fixed-geometry approximation
every accepted descent step saves its driver sample's full LP inputs (tendon map, contact map, target, limits, friction) so the verifier replays without physics
phase 2 re-runs the unchanged gate chain with force audit and margin LP on terminal poses
an undecided LP is recorded as unresolved, never as physical infeasibility
no actuator, controller, CNS or dynamic trial is executed
success_criterion: Every declared seed executes within probe/wall budgets; terminal poses are physically certified; all saved LPs replay under the verifier; the aggregate outcome follows the declared rules.
falsification: A certified feasible passive subsystem rejects 'no pose in this contact family balances'; nonzero floors at all seeds strengthen the contact-configuration constraint to live geometry, not just a saved map.

parameters.descent_dofs: every non-root DOF row (actuated and passive); the six free-root DOF rows are held fixed
parameters.objective: passive-subsystem minimum scaled balance error with LIVE contact re-derivation per probe: first-contact height, depth grid, contacts, tendon limits and bias target are all recomputed at each trial pose; the residual is the minimum over root-feasible depth samples
parameters.descent_rule: deterministic cyclic coordinate descent in row order; per-DOF step h_rel*(joint range), h_rel starts at 0.25 and halves after any sweep without improvement
parameters.verification: replay of saved-input LPs in the same SciPy/HiGHS family; no independent physics or biological check
parameters.scope: Static witness generation; contacts are re-derived per probe but this is a bounded declared search, not global posture optimization; no dynamic or biological claim
